written.headline: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as AI spending grows
written.summary: Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees, or roughly 27% of its global workforce, as the company increases spending on artificial intelligence. The voluntary exit offer was made available to eligible staff in Canada, India, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

written.headline: Asian tech stocks plunge amid fears US Democrats may delay data centers
written.summary: Asian stock markets tied to the artificial intelligence boom plummeted on Friday morning following a tech sell-off amid fears that US Democrats may delay data centers. Taiwan's Taiex saw a record intraday point drop, the Kospi fell 8.7%, and the Nikkei fell 6.7%.

written.headline: OpenAI steps back from NDAs and promises full power costs for data centers
written.summary: OpenAI announced it will no longer use non-disclosure agreements with public officials for data center projects and will pay the full cost of electricity and infrastructure. The policy shift follows voter opposition to data center expansion in the U.S. midterm elections.

written.headline: Sarvam launches Prism open-weight decision model built on Sarvam 105B
written.summary: Sarvam AI has launched Prism, an open-weight decision model built on its Sarvam 105B foundation model for enterprise workflows. The model achieves an average score of 71.8 across three evaluation indices with a median response time of 44 milliseconds on an Nvidia B200 GPU.
